title: Reproducibility materials for Training Context Construction and Calibration for Evidence Gating in Retrieval Augmented Question Answering
description:
Reproducibility data and code for the study of training context construction and calibration for evidence gating. The archives contain experimental inputs, saved predictions, independent calibration and public-benchmark evaluation records, numerical reproduction scripts, training protocols, and figure sources.

Reuse terms are component-specific. DATA_SOURCES.md identifies the upstream sources, changes, and applicable licenses. The record is publicly accessible. Its archive-level license label does not replace any component license or grant additional reuse rights.
